definitions.explanation: A specific position or place on a map or on the ground. Often used in technical, official, or news contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{地点|ちてん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧5⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きている→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Traffic jams are occurring 5km from the accident site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{地点|ちてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}ろう→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: Let's go back to the starting point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧{地点|ちてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I confirmed the destination on the map.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{地点|ちてん} (starting point)
- ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧{地点|ちてん} (destination point)
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{地点|ちてん} (accident site)
- ⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧{地点|ちてん} (observation point)
- ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧{地点|ちてん} (current location)

USAGE: {地点|ちてん} is more technical/precise than ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (place) and is often used in:
- Traffic reports
- Navigation
- Scientific observations
- Official reports

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地点|ちてん} - precise location, technical
- ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ - general place, everyday usage
